name: WPA NEWS · SEVEN PULSE
rules: The tapan is the foundational pulse; other instruments support rather than obscure it.
The result must sound like a contemporary international news identity, not a folk song placed under news.
No music bed under tragic or highly sensitive news unless editorially justified.
All masters and stems must be original or appropriately licensed.

opening.arc: tapan pulse -> traditional timbre -> orchestral and modern broadcast build -> sonic logo on WPA ВЕСТИ reveal

closing.arc: same 7/8 genetic code -> calmer reduction -> short kaval colour -> final seven-pulse sonic resolve

sonic_logo.purpose: recognisable WPA audio signature usable independently of picture
